products.product_description: Tillamook Mudslide ice cream (item #63006), packaged in 3 gallon tub. UPC 0 72830 63006 1. The label is read in parts: "***TILLAMOOK MUDSLIDE ICE CREAM*** ALLERGEN INFORMATION: This product contains milk, peanut, soy, tree nut (coconut), egg. It is made with equipment that also makes product containing wheat.***"
products.reason_for_recall: Tillamook Mudslide ice cream (item #63006), packaged in 3-gallon tub, is recalled because product contains trace amounts of undeclared color additives Amaranth and Yellow No. 6 in the chocolate freckles and chocolate fudge pieces ingredients.
